sources.document_title: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (As Introduced in Lok Sabha)
sources.official_gazette_details: Not published in Gazette as an Act; printed by Government of India Press under printer mark MGIPMRND-277LS(S3)-10-08-2023
sources.enacted_by: Unenacted legislative draft bill introduced in Lok Sabha by Shri Amit Shah (Minister of Home Affairs)
sources.commencement_authority: N/A (Introduced bill does not have legal commencement)
explicit_limitations: This document is an introduced bill, NOT the final enacted Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Act No. 46 of 2023).
Clause numbering, procedural wording, and First Schedule classifications (Cognizable/Bailable) were amended during parliamentary passage.
Enforceable procedural claims must cite Act No. 46 of 2023 published in Gazette No. 54 / 63 (25 Dec 2023), not this bill.
Extracted text represents legislative history / draft reference only; it is not binding law.
sources.legal_status_notice: UNENACTED INTRODUCED BILL (Bill No. 122 of 2023). This document is NOT the final enacted BNSS Act No. 46 of 2023. It contains pre-enactment draft clauses and schedules. DO NOT rely on this document for enforceable procedural law.

sources.commencement_authority: Ministry of Home Affairs Notification S.O. 848(E), dated 23 February 2024 (commenced 1 July 2024, except First Schedule entry for Section 106(2) BNS)
explicit_limitations: Contains procedural criminal law and schedule classifications only; does not define substantive penal offenses.
First Schedule entry regarding BNS Section 106(2) (hit-and-run) is held in abeyance / uncommenced per S.O. 848(E).
Appointed commencement date is 1 July 2024; pre-commencement investigations/proceedings continue under CrPC 1973 per Section 531 BNSS savings clause.
Extracted text provides machine-readable reference; legal content verification requires primary Gazette cross-check.
sources.legal_status_notice: ENACTED STATUTE (Act No. 46 of 2023). Governs criminal procedure for offenses investigated or tried on or after 1 July 2024. Contains authoritative First Schedule classifications (Cognizable/Non-Cognizable, Bailable/Non-Bailable, Court of Trial).
